verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the v3 API's S&E services, which list 'Manage transactions & reimbursements'. S&E webhook event notifications could plausibly support status tracking, but nothing describes the employee-facing flow. Missing for 10: an employee out-of-pocket expense submission flow, reimbursement by direct deposit/ACH to employees, any payout timing ('in days'), end-to-end submission-to-payout status tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
